g.title: PGCLNS
g.text: PG-CLNS — Pheromone-Guided Cooperative Large Neighborhood Search

Population of ants (ACS construction) coached by an adaptive LNS with simulated-annealing acceptance; the best member deposits pheromone that guides the next generation. Objective: maximise profit = R·Σ collected waste − C·Σ distance, subject to vehicle capacity and mandatory-bin coverage.

g.title: cluster_lns
g.text: — LNSSolver.solve(initial_solution) (Pisinger & Ropke ALNS with SA acceptance)

g.title: a_params
g.text: Load area params: capacity, R (revenue / kg scaled),

g.title: a_sub
g.text: vrpp: all bins, mandatory = selected list

g.title: a_map
g.text: flat tour: 0 r1… 0 r2… 0 · compute km on full matrix

g.title: i_cand
g.text: Candidate lists: k nearest neighbours per node

g.title: i_constr
g.text: SolutionConstructor (ACS ant, α=1, β=2, q₀, ρ=0.1)

g.title: m_pop
g.text: cost = Σ route km · profit = R·Σ waste − C·cost

g.title: l_init
g.text: profit = R·Σ waste − C·km · T = start_temp (100)

g.title: m_pher
g.text: evaporate all stored edges: τ ← (1−ρ)·τ, floor τ_min
deposit Δ on every arc of best routes (depot→r₀, rₖ→rₖ₊₁, r_last→depot),

g.title: m_repl
g.text: canonicalise, recompute cost & profit, overwrite slot

g.title: c_prof_q
g.text: no node j with R·w_j > C·(d₀ⱼ + dⱼ₀) ?

g.title: c_new
g.text: open new route: route = [], load = 0, current = depot

g.title: c_feas
g.text: feasible = { j ∈ unvisited : load + w_j ≤ capacity and
( j mandatory or R·w_j > C·(d_cur,j + d_j,0 − d_cur,0) ) }

g.title: c_close
g.text: close route (return to depot), append to routes

g.title: c_local
g.text: ACS local update on arc (cur, next):

g.title: c_step
g.text: unvisited −= next · mandatory_unvisited −= next · cur = next

g.title: l_select
g.text: roulette-wheel select destroy op d and repair op r

g.title: l_repair
g.text: greedy cheapest insertion or regret-2 insertion
